turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She is very insistent about the feast. I trust you will all ensure everything is as she wishes, Father.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Yes, yes, my son, of course we will see to it all. Your mother… she has always been particular, and it is good to honor her wishes, isn't it? We will make sure everything is just so, for her peace of mind.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: The maid is agreeable to the arrangements. I believe she will be a good help to the household, Father.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is good to have a good help, yes, a strong back and willing hands are always a blessing. Your mother… she always knew how to pick a good one, didn’t she? I trust you will guide her well, my son, and she will learn the ways of our house.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Now she will be well, yet!

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
